name: QuantGym Collector
shortDescription: Capture LeetCode and quant interview problems into your QuantGym study board.
detailedDescription: QuantGym Collector helps QuantGym beta users capture a problem page from LeetCode or another interview-prep site, preview the extracted title, prompt, source, difficulty, and tags, then send that structured problem into QuantGym. If the capture is too large for a URL handoff, the extension copies JSON so the user can paste it manually. The extension runs only when the user opens the popup and clicks a command.
singlePurpose: Capture the current problem page into QuantGym for study tracking.

permissionJustifications.activeTab: Used only after the user opens the popup, so the extension can read the active problem page.
permissionJustifications.scripting: Used to run the page extraction script on the active tab after user interaction.
permissionJustifications.storage: Used to remember the user's preferred QuantGym board URL locally in Chrome.

reviewNotes: Captured content is sent only to the user-configured QuantGym board URL or copied to the clipboard by explicit user action.
